_README: Single source of truth for ArcticBlue speaker/targeting personas. Read by the Day-Of briefing route (api/briefing.py) and baked into the tracker UI by src/build.py (drives the persona-scored suggestions in Plan Ahead + My Lineup). 'geo' tokens are matched by geoHit(): broad-region words (US & Canada, Europe, Latin America, Asia-Pacific, Africa, MENA, global-flagship) match an event's canonical region; anything else is treated as a city/country name matched against the event's location text (accent-folded). 'mode' forks scoring + briefs: room = work the floor for buyers (geo + buyers is enough); stage = there to speak (needs a topical theme match). Default targeting rule: stay within the listed geographies unless an event is exceptionally high-quality, in which case it's a flagged exception, not the default.  GEO: Thor, Verma and Joe share the full major-business-hub city list (incl. Las Vegas) — any major hub works for all three. Australian cities are deliberately excluded (Australia was removed from Verma 2026-07-28). Joe keeps 'US & Canada' as a broad token ON TOP of the hubs so he doesn't lose continent-wide coverage.

joe.name: Joe Lalley
flags: audience-first: HR / L&D / People leaders, not technical practitioners
primary ~85% = enterprise HR/L&D/People Ops events; secondary ~15% = enterprise AI / digital-transformation events only when an HR/CLO/CHRO-level audience is confirmed or plausible
exclude purely technical (engineering/IT-only) events — no people angle, no fit

carlos.name: Carlos Chacon Almeida
signature_angles: ArcticBlue de-risks the AI bet before a 6-7 figure contract
carlos.outcome_target: 3+ qualified mid-market/enterprise buyer conversations; contacts captured
flags: US & Canada are the densest mid-market buying environments (primary); Mexico City + the Caribbean (Santo Domingo, where Carlos is based; San Juan) are strong secondary
broader LatAm (Sao Paulo, Bogota, Buenos Aires) = flag separately — longer cycles, stronger banking/telco/government adjacency
fintech is the top-priority industry
company size: 100-500 mid-market and larger

jerome.name: Jerome Wouters
themes: AI governance in the European regulatory context
signature_angles: 90% of enterprise AI fails on uncertainty — experiment, don't roadmap
vendor feasibility testing before the big contract
jerome.outcome_target: 3+ qualified EMEA enterprise conversations; contacts captured
flags: UK, Zurich, and DACH are the densest enterprise AI buying markets — prioritize there first
target 500+ employee enterprises
Northern Africa leads should be flagged separately from core European deals

thor.name: Thor Ernstsson
signature_angles: 90%+ of enterprise AI initiatives fail on uncertainty, not tech — go/pivot/kill beats the 12-18 month roadmap
flags: INDUSTRY = healthcare / healthtech / digital health / life sciences (Thor is the healthcare lead; insurance & regulated finance belong to Verma)
executive/strategic level — enterprise AI adoption at scale, governance frameworks, proving ROI, not deep technical implementation
NYC/SF/DC/Las Vegas/Miami primary US; London/Zurich + Gulf (Riyadh/Dubai/Abu Dhabi) international; Mexico City + Sao Paulo secondary LatAm
author/keynote-tier: check for open speaker route; weight prestige introductions

verma.name: Anuraag Verma
signature_angles: regulated industries: the cost of a wrong AI bet is highest — validate before you scale
verma.outcome_target: 1 board/C-suite speaking or advisory conversation + 2 regulated-industry leads
flags: board-level / C-suite audiences in regulated sectors (insurance is the lead — finance/banking, capital markets, fintech); healthcare belongs to Thor, not Verma
governance & transformation as a headline theme is the strongest fit signal
NOT wealth / asset management, and 'chief risk' is not a fit signal on its own
Australia is NO LONGER Verma's territory (removed 2026-07-28) — AU events match on their own merits like anywhere else
same major-city list as Thor, but no LatAm

jim.name: Jim
signature_angles: AI for the public sector: adoption at agency scale, done responsibly
flags: fit = anything government / public sector / federal / defense
target Washington DC especially — the densest public-sector market — but government events elsewhere in the US count too

arcticblue.voice: Direct, practitioner-to-practitioner. No hype, no filler, no invented numbers.
proof_points: 90%+ of enterprise AI initiatives fail on uncertainty, not technology
never_fabricate: event details not in the source data or web-confirmed
